question.problem: Given that the continuous random variable $Y$ is uniformly distributed on the interval $[-3,7],$ compute $P(Y>3).$

current_example.problem: Given that the continuous random variable $Y$ is uniformly distributed on the interval $\left[1, 16\right],$ compute $P\left(Y  \geq  10\right).$
current_example.worked_solution:
The probability density function for a uniformly distributed continuous random variable $Y$ on an interval $[a,b]$ is given by

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14270027/assets/52b1844375e91979dd922a3bb6011a214136a370cfd96bc74e6ce8d7afe22fa6.svg)

Our random variable $Y$ is uniformly distributed on the interval $\left[1, 16\right],$ so it has the following probability density function:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14270027/assets/0edc32b500fce9d03067a2a82fab66d7ac2c68d0fc60899738998e1e7b6eeb53.svg)

So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}P(Y\ge 10) & =P(10\le Y\le 16) \\  & ={\int }_{10}^{16}f(y)\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{10}^{16}\frac{1}{15}\,\text{d}y \\  & =\frac{16-10}{15} \\  & =\frac{6}{15} \\  & =\frac{2}{5}.\end{aligned}
$$
